SURESH D 
• +91 9442993905 | sureshlakh3030@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/suresh-d | github.com/sureshlakh3030 
P R O F E S S I O N A L   S U M M A R Y 
Third-Year  of  AI  &  Data  Science  undergraduate  with  hands-on  project  experience  in  Generative  AI  (RAG 
pipelines,  LLMs)  and  applied  Machine  Learning  (predictive  maintenance,  computer  vision).  Proficient  in 
Python,  LangChain,  XGBoost,  and  Streamlit.  Passionate  about  building  scalable,  explainable  AI  systems. 
Seeking an AI/ML internship to contribute to real-world AI product development. 
E D U C A T I O N 
B TECH – Artificial Intelligence & Data Science Pursuing 3
rd
 year 
Sri Shakthi Institute of Engineering & Technology Coimbatore 
 
P R O J E C T S 
RAG DOCUMENT ASSISTANT | Stack: Python, FastAPI, LLaMA3, FAISS, SQLite, React, Vite 
• Built end-to-end RAG Pipeline using LLaMa3,FAISS 
• Developed  FastAPI REST  backend  with  10+  endpoints  for  chat,  document  management,  and  project 
switching 
• Implemented SQLite-based persistent conversation history across sessions and projects 
• Designed  responsive  React  +  Vite  frontend  with  dark/light  theme,  mobile  support,  and  real-time  Q&A 
interface 
• Reduced hallucinations through document-level context isolation and chunking strategies 
 
CROWD PANIC | Stack: Python, CNN, OpenCV, Telegram Bot API 
 
• Trained CNN model to classify crowd panic behavior from live video frames using OpenCV  
• Built real-time Telegram Bot integration to automatically dispatch alerts to authorities on panic detection  
• Developed monitoring UI with live crowd density indicators, visual alerts, and acknowledgment controls  
• Implemented full video pipeline: frame extraction → preprocessing → CNN inference → alert trigger 
 
AI-POWERED PREDICTIVE MAINTENANCE SYSTEM| Stack: Python, XGBoost, SHAP, Streamlit, Plotly 
 
• Trained XGBoost classifier on AI4I sensor  dataset  achieving 98.35%  accuracy, 86.76%  recall, 98.15% 
ROC-AUC  
• Built interactive Streamlit + Plotly dashboard with 5+ real-time KPIs and proactive maintenance alerts  
• Implemented SHAP explainability layer providing feature-level insights for non-technical stakeholders  
Designed   modular   ML   pipeline   covering   data   ingestion,   feature   engineering,   model   training,   and 
deployment

• Python for Data Science, AI & Development – IBM (Coursera), Oct 2025 
• Participated  in  Yuvaa  AI  Stack  Challenge – Regional  AI  Fullstack  Innovation  Summit  2026,  hosted  by 
Yuvaasoft Technologies Pvt Ltd. & Sri Ramakrishna Institute of Technology, Coimbatore

Generative AI: RAG, LLMs, Embeddings, Prompt Engineering
